records.name: Power Pole
records.evidence: The current Dragon Ball Wiki Bōjutsu reference states that in Xenoverse 2 the Power Pole and Power Pole Combo Super Skills can be obtained by the Future Warrior regardless of race. This is direct unrestricted CaC evidence, not an inference from GT Goku ownership.

records.name: Power Pole Combo
records.evidence: The same Xenoverse 2 Bōjutsu reference explicitly states that the Power Pole and Power Pole Combo Super Skills can be obtained by the Future Warrior regardless of race. The evidence applies to both named Super Skills.
